record.title: Functional Neural Networks: Shift invariant models for functional data with applications to EEG classification
record.reason: Focused PDF review resolves the generic-method boundary. Section 1 motivates the architecture with continuous EEG brain-computer interfaces; Section 5.1 uses EEG-inspired simulations, Section 5.2 provides ancillary phoneme and meat-spectrometry benchmarks, and Section 5.3 devotes the main application study to real EEG from nine BCI Competition IV 2a participants. Classic, sliding-window, and per-time motor-imagery decoding are evaluated in depth against EEGNet. The substantial human neurophysiology objective and experiments make the study biomedical-led despite generic functional-data tests.
